g.text: Objective: keep the company only if it is cheap on at least one value indicator against its sector, and score how cheap.

text.tspan: a value indicator passed
score = (threshold − value) ÷ threshold, clipped to [0, 1]
(threshold = 0.7 × sector median)
free cash flow yield: score = min(1, yield ÷ minimum)
value metric = highest score among passing indicators
no value indicator passed
the company is rejected, and every failed indicator is recorded
every value indicator was skipped
the company is rejected, and a skip records no failed rule
pe_below_industry_multiple
price-to-earnings (P/E) < 0.7 × sector median P/E
skipped: median or company P/E missing or ≤ 0
ev_ebitda_below_industry_multiple
enterprise value (EV)
earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization (EBITDA)
EV/EBITDA < 0.7 × sector median EV/EBITDA
skipped: median or company EV/EBITDA missing or ≤ 0
pbv_below_industry_multiple_with_roe_above_median
price-to-book-value (P/BV) < 0.7 × sector median P/BV
and return on equity (ROE) > sector median ROE
skipped: sector P/BV median ≤ 0,
a median or company figure missing,
or company P/BV ≤ 0
fcf_yield_above
free cash flow yield > 8%
skipped: yield missing; no sector benchmark needed
Comes out:
the company with its value metric and its failed indicators, on to the trap detectors whatever the result
a value indicator passes; its score is the value metric
[a value indicator passes and none fails]
a value indicator passes; its score is the value metric
[a value indicator passes and none fails]
a value indicator passes and another fails; the failure is recorded
[a value indicator passes and another fails]
a value indicator passes and another fails; the failure is recorded
[a value indicator passes and another fails]

g.text: no value indicator passes [one fails, the others fail or are skipped]
no value indicator passes [one fails, the others fail or are skipped]
all four value indicators are skipped [a median or a company figure is missing]
all four value indicators are skipped [a median or a company figure is missing]
on to the trap detectors [always: every layer runs]
on to the trap detectors [always: every layer runs]
on to the trap detectors [always: every layer runs]
